description: "Welcome to 'Going to space'! 🚀 We are excited to join the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge under the Dubai Local Event, focusing on 'The Earth Information Jukebox'. We are looking for creative and passionate teammates who want to build something amazing together. We need skills in coding, AI, data analysis, research, and graphic design. If you love space exploration, creative storytelling, and turning bold ideas into reality, join our team today and let's make an impact!"
